text:
harper: Quick ping - onboarding sample app fails when built for Edge on some bundlers. Vite dev OK; Vite build + Vercel Edge runtime crashes. Repro and notes below.

jon: Can you share the error?

harper: Runtime stack from Edge: 
``nTypeError: Cannot redefine property: exports
    at Object.defineProperty (<anonymous>)
    at Object.<anonymous> (/var/task/node_modules/@redwood/inference-js/dist/cjs/index.js:11:14)
```

harper: Build prerender shows: 
``nSyntaxError: The requested module '/node_modules/@redwood/inference-js/dist/cjs/index.js' does not provide an export named 'createEmbedding'
```

priya: Sounds like bundlers are resolving the CJS export for an ESM import. Which SDK version?

harper: @redwood/inference-js@2.1.0-canary.2026.03.28. Downgrading to 2.0.x avoids the defineProperty crash but then our tsc fails due to types.

yasmin: What TS error do you see?

harper: tsc on CI: 
``nsrc/lib/inference.ts:8:10 - error TS2322: Type 'InferenceClient' is not assignable to type 'ClientFactory'.
8 const client = new InferenceClient(cfg)
```
The package's .d.ts exports a factory type while runtime exposes a class.

jon: Short-term workarounds: (1) Vite: ssr.noExternal: ['@redwood/inference-js'] so Vite bundles the ESM sources; (2) Webpack/Rollup: alias to '@redwood/inference-js/dist/esm/index.js'; (3) Explicit ESM import: `import { createEmbedding } from '@redwood/inference-js/dist/esm/index.js'`.

priya: Small shim that helped: create shims/redwood-esm.js with `export * from '@redwood/inference-js/dist/esm/index.js'` and alias the package to that in bundler. Not ideal but unblocks onboarding.

yasmin: Filed infra-inference#2417 with repro, gist and logs. @sdk-packaging-bot started a CI matrix (vite/rollup/webpack).

sdk-packaging-bot: CI started for infra-inference#2417  matrix=vite|rollup|webpack node=18|20.

jon: Long-term fix plan: (A) normalize package.json exports to prefer ESM/import for browsers/bundlers, (B) rebuild CJS without redefining exports (remove defineProperty shims), (C) update .d.ts to reflect the runtime constructor/class and add a TS smoke-test in CI.

harper: I've updated the sampleapp onboarding docs with the Vite snippet and alias workaround while we patch the SDK. Will update the ticket when the canary lands.

dev-bot: Noted - assigning sdk-packaging for triage.

jon: I'll open a minor release PR to fix exports + types and add npm pack consumer tests to CI.

harper: Thanks everyone. Leaving repro in the ticket and will post updates here when fixes publish.
